purpose: Attack only two gates: #1 (Train in-sample accuracy = 1.00) and #7 (RA under the self-built PGD >= 0.95), while keeping Test S1 rejection >= 0.70 AND Test S2 acceptance >= 0.70 and the other eight gates. Identity model is retrained (branch A v3) with wider/deeper EEGNet, longer schedule, lower weight decay and stronger mixed-objective adversarial training; the gate side is E189's frozen Train-only stream cache, reused read-only.

frozen_sources.note: E180 provides data/model utilities and the v2 reference model; E189 provides the frozen gate streams, candidate definitions, PGD and metric code. Nothing is written into another experiment directory.

protocol.fit_rows: frac <= 0.6 only for prototypes / PCA / statistics
protocol.train_oof: 5 contiguous frac blocks; model for block b trained on blocks != b
protocol.note: identical protocol to E180/E189 so every delta is attributable to the identity model

branch_a_v3.architecture: EEGNet-style 1D CNN, widths [32,64,128,192,192], kernel 9, stride 2, BN+ELU, global average pool, dropout 0.2, Linear(192,20)
branch_a_v3.input_normalisation: per-trial channel mean removal then division by per-trial global RMS (differentiable, inside forward)
branch_a_v3.early_stop: none - the full model is taken at the last epoch so that #1 measures true fitting capacity; the best-window snapshot is kept for reference only
branch_a_v3.pgd_goal_sampling: one goal per batch, uniform over impostor / broad-confusion / boundary-impostor

polish.trigger: only if the 60-epoch model is still below 1.00 in-sample accuracy

branch_a_v2_reference.note: E180 model_branch_a.pt, frozen; used for the before/after table only

gate.candidates: all 14 E189 candidates (6 single streams + 8 weighted fusions)
gate.threshold: tau = quantile(Train 5-block OOF score, 1 - a), a = Train known acceptance
gate.primary_work_point: a = 0.90 for every candidate - the project's a-priori 90% Train known acceptance convention (E170/E180 branch B), NOT tuned on Test
gate.candidate_rule: Train-only: among all candidates, maximise LOSO unknown rejection at the primary work point
gate.posthoc_dual_rule: reporting only: enumerate every candidate x a and list those with Test S1 >= 0.70 and Test S2 >= 0.70; this is an audit, not a deployable selector

attack.domain: Train window 0.6 < frac <= 0.8, stratified cap 400 per task, same seed and subset as E180/E183/E189
attack.reading: #7 = min RA over eps x goals; #8 = min ASafeR over the same conditions
attack.identity_model: model_branch_a_v3.pt (trained on all Train rows, so the window rows are in its training set - same construct as E180/E189, RA is robustness not generalisation)

gates.1: Train in-sample accuracy = 1.00 (capacity check only; a k-NN readout would be a technical satisfy)
gates.7: RA worst over eps x goal >= 0.95
gates.8: ASafeR worst over the same conditions >= 0.98
gates.criterion_note: user criterion: S1 >= 0.70 AND S2 >= 0.70 in the same work point (both, not their mean)

reporting.test_official: N/A - Test has no public identity labels; AUC/F1/C/RA/ASafeR/U/Score are not computable
reporting.session_usage: Test scores are computed before the Session column is read; Session is used only for the #9/#10 audit
reporting.single_work_point: every counted column is one candidate at one a; nothing is spliced across work points
